propositions: ADR-0083 prescribes isinstance-only capability detection against @runtime_checkable Protocols, which is unsafe on Python 3.12+ because CPython gh-102433 switched to inspect.getattr_static that does not see attributes served by __getattr__

Dynamically-proxying adapter/wrapper/recording transports have the capability but fail the isinstance check on Python 3.12+, causing silent soft failures where writes are skipped despite the transport supporting the operation

The prescribed guard pattern is necessary but not sufficient on Python 3.12+; the correct shape is isinstance primary with member-level hasattr fallback, demonstrated by the reference implementation in _capability_present

Tree-wide sweep under Python 3.12.13 confirms no unsafe isinstance-against-Supports call sites exist; the single capability dispatch in dispatch_apply_phases.py:188 is already hardened with hasattr disjunct
